name: lsc-tig-awards tig_2016_2017
description: LSC Technology Initiative Grant (TIG) rounds 2016 and 2017 as printed on LSC's per-year project description pages (read from the Internet Archive's June 2019 captures: the old lsc.gov addresses now open LSC's TIG index page, which has no 2016 or 2017 list), with every amount LSC's press releases still on lsc.gov print for the same grants, the per-grantee totals those releases state, and LSC's own counts and dollar figures for each round. Read from the raw text of each document and hand-checked. Compiled by MV2 of Munim, Inc. with AI agents working in his name. CC BY 4.0.

fields.rounds[].page: Internet Archive capture of LSC's project description page for the round; its list is the record here
fields.rounds[].page_today: the page's old lsc.gov address, which now opens LSC's TIG index page with no list for the round
fields.rounds[].sources: LSC press releases on lsc.gov that print amounts for some or all of the round's grants: release (the round's announcement), bundle (2016: per-grantee releases bundled on one page), pbif_bundle (the same year's Pro Bono Innovation Fund per-grantee releases, some of which also announce a TIG)
fields.grants[].grantee: grantee name as printed on the description page (runs of spaces made single)
fields.grants[].state: two-letter code for the grantee's state or territory, read from its name and project description
fields.grants[].printed: amount as printed on the description page; null where the page prints none
fields.amounts: by source and TIG number, the amount each release prints in its text for that grant
fields.grantee_totals[]: a total a release states for one grantee's grants together
fields.headings[]: a per-grantee release heading whose TIG amount differs from the amount in the same release's text
fields.statements[]: one statement by LSC about the round, quoted from the source: counts of grants, organizations, states and territories (null where not given) and a dollar figure as a rule: more_than X, nearly X (read only as 'less than X'), about X (rounds to X at the nearest $0.1 million)
